subject: Information Theory
title: Entropy and Consciousness
description: A 60-second lesson on Entropy and Consciousness.

hook.text: Under anesthesia, your brain's entropy drops. When you wake, it rises. Could entropy measure consciousness itself?

buildup.text: Researchers measured the entropy of brain signals in awake, sleeping, and anesthetized patients.

discovery.text: Conscious states show higher entropy than unconscious ones. The brain generates more unpredictable activity.

twist.text: Psychedelic states show even higher entropy than normal waking. More conscious or just more chaotic?

climax.text: The entropic brain hypothesis proposes that consciousness sits at the edge of order and disorder.

quiz.question: What does the entropic brain hypothesis suggest?
options: Conscious states have higher brain signal entropy
Entropy is unrelated to brain activity
